text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Eishin Flash, victor of multiple GⅠs at 
Tokyo Racecourse. At an event held to 
honor her historic record—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She shared her feelings about the race. 
They took the form of a commemorative 
monument, captured in a photograph 
alongside the Trainer who walked beside 
her.
